CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.
   D. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.
   D. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   C. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   C. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gifts of the Holy Spirit 8 5.0 Christian Living Today and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
